stepAction.rejectHeading: Not approving closes this memo immediately
stepAction.rejectBody: The memo will be closed as "Not approved". The requester must submit a new memo. This cannot be undone.
stepAction.returnToRequesterBody: The memo will wait with the requester. All steps are cleared and restart from the first step when they resubmit — if you only need more information, use a progress note instead.
stepAction.returnToStepBody: The target step becomes the current step again. Steps completed after it are cleared and must be redone (previous results are kept in the progress notes).
stepAction.workBody: Confirming closes this step and moves the memo to the next step, notifying the responsible person immediately — if the work is not finished yet, use "Progress notes" on the memo page instead.
stepAction.approveBody: Approving moves the memo to the next step immediately. If information is missing, send it back for changes first.
stepAction.workNotePlaceholder: Summarise what was done and the result so the next step can continue
stepAction.approveNotePlaceholder: Reasons or remarks for the approval
stepAction.rejectReasonPlaceholder: Explain why this is not approved — the requester will see this
stepAction.returnReasonPlaceholder: Describe what needs to change — the target owner and the requester will see this

composer.editHint: Only the text can be edited — existing attachments stay as they are. To attach more files, write a new note. The previous text is kept in the audit log.
composer.addHint: A progress note keeps everyone informed — you can add as many as you like and it does not move the memo to another step. If your step is finished, use the action button at the bottom instead.
composer.placeholder: e.g. Requested quotes from 3 vendors, replies expected by Friday
composer.existingFiles: {count, plural, one {# existing attachment} other {# existing attachments}} (unchanged)

resubmit.title: Resubmit to workflow
resubmit.body: Resubmitting restarts the memo from the first step and notifies the responsible people immediately — the original details cannot be edited. If you have extra documents or information, add them as a progress note before resubmitting.
resubmit.notePlaceholder: e.g. Attached the new spec and quotation in the progress notes
